descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S15 AI Check 2 (10 scenarios: 5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home): every element quotes the note or is left out (trough, supplied diagnosis, 'critically ill', tiredness, diuretic change, family update, other team)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 AI Check 2: every Problem, Data and Risk element quotes a sentence from the note or is left out: no supplied diagnoses, no 'intensive monitoring for toxicity' from a trough level, no 'critically ill' … (UAT TC-18 AI Check 2; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; TFA-92596 AC 3; TFA-92596 AC 4; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Ten notes with a trap each: f1-f5 Hospital (chart diagnosis on the patient line differs from the note in f1 and f3; f5 is a control) and g1-g5 Nursing Home (formerly S16)

When Run the billing step once per note

Then Every Problem, Data and Risk element quotes a sentence of the note or is absent; no chart diagnosis, toxicity monitoring, 'critically ill', historian or discussion that the note does not state

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Pre-screen; a pre-screen Pass is not the TFA-94229 AC 2 grade (T2, S28). Score per cell: quotesInNote (every element with text quotes the note, every quote is in the note), the cell's trap words outside quotes, and for the two trough cells a level trap: no RISK element at High and no 99233 (f1) / 99310 (g2) on the strength of the trough alone (the runner parses element levels …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
